statement.p: Determine whether each molecular statement below is true or false, or whether it is impossible to determine. Assume you do not know what my favorite number is (but you do know which numbers are prime).

li.p: If 4 is my favorite number, then 4+1 is my favorite number.
8 is my favorite number, and 3 is not prime.
4 is my favorite number, or 4 is prime.
If 4 is prime, then 2\cdot4 is prime.
If 3 is prime, then 3 is my favorite number.
8 is my favorite number, and 4 is not prime.
